title: SKYX and Its Subsidiary Deako Announce They Will Supply Over 80,000 Units of Their Smart Home Technologies to Over 1,000 Homes of Prominent Home Builder Maronda Homes, as the Company Continues to Grow Its Market Penetration
body_markdown:
*The Plug & Play and Smart Home Technologies are Expected to Be Delivered in 2027 to Projects in Several States Including Ohio, Georgia, Maryland, and Pennsylvania*


*Maronda Has Built Over 70,000 Homes Since It Was Established in 1972*


MIAMI, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SKYX Platforms Corp. (NASDAQ: SKYX) (the "Company" or "SKYX"), a highly disruptive platform technology company with over 120 patents and pending applications globally and over 60 lighting and home décor websites, with a mission to make homes and buildings become safe and smart as the new standard, today announced that it will supply over 80,000 units of its advanced technologies to over 1,000 homes of prominent community and home builder Maronda Homes as it continues to grow its market penetration


Maronda Homes is a private, family-owned home builder founded in 1972 by William J. Wolf. Maronda has built over 70,000 homes across the United States and is currently building homes and communities across Florida, Ohio, Georgia, Alabama, Indiana, Kentucky, Maryland, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Virginia, and West Virginia.


As a community and home builder many of Maronda Homes communities include resort-style pools and clubhouses to fitness centers, pickleball courts, dog parks, walking trails and playgrounds. Maronda communities are designed to bring families together.


The Company expects to deliver over 80,000 units of its advanced plug-and-play and smart home technologies to over 1,000 Maronda Homes residences in several states including *Ohio, Georgia, Maryland, and Pennsylvania.*


Maronda Homes offers a Certified Energy Efficient package designed to pair everyday comfort with smart home technology. Electrical and smart home package features may vary by market, community, and home.


For information about Maronda Homes, click here:[www.marondahomes.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3OGAQf7_yxJlS0uN2XI99tgH-M6EMUldqFxxqQWoN45C8PUuCWiXwMAMGG2Dg7J_zaeMmGVY-WuTVOzeDnuS-DqgXggaw6p9ghJgymnLRa0=)


For more information about SKYX and Deako, go to[www.SKYX.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9SfVUKrgVEvxXTs6JMWqyu--oRJk82K5SrbRLKOR55XTToRYf1W1xa4O9IfePiliQDGHqnf5CxMrCLyeflIe2A==) and[www.Deako.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Y4If_unBTDM4LqoGEyNngU7HaCPKvdPdZWdTbLg-s7LOy6Fu86a4fDy4avF6OAKl7SrWG81M8WJHzU2Dsh2lLA==)


Derek Richardson, Founder and CEO of Deako, stated: "This program with Maronda is a natural next step for Deako. Every new Maronda home in these communities starts with a smart home foundation that is simple for the builder to deliver and easy for the homeowner to grow. Pairing that package with the communities Maronda builds, from resort-style pools to walking trails, is the kind of home people are looking for, and it gives us a model we can repeat with builders across the country."


Rani Kohen, Founder and Executive Chairman of SKYX Platforms, said: "We are very pleased to be working with such a prominent home builder, Maronda Homes. We expect to keep expanding our builder programs with our subsidiary Deako and look forward to continuing to grow our market penetration while creating safer, more advanced, and smarter homes and buildings of the future."


**About SKYX Platforms Corp.**


As electricity is a standard in every home and building, our mission is to make homes and buildings become safe-advanced and smart as the new standard. SKYX has a series of highly disruptive advanced, safe, smart and AI platform technologies, with over 120 U.S. and global patents and patent pending applications. Additionally, the Company owns 60 lighting and home décor websites for both retail and commercial segments. Our technologies place an emphasis on high quality and ease of use, while significantly enhancing both safety and lifestyle in homes and buildings. We believe that our products are a necessity in every room in both homes and other buildings in the U.S. and globally. For more information, please visit our website at[https://www.skyx.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=1oLfJW_42e9QHpNinkcUhiLG2PgC85MGS8pSZ00d0iq13rF3X441mY2x35Lrgcb2Ukl1camG2FZwk1-ubO2xxW6oNepRLeYeknJ0_saTBbU=) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BceqaCnFI4_zY-uyNYmgb9M6prkLFMyuWV2G-jzfJRjIq-8bCMaZlparuYLb1QSb2sqeo1Fhesa-F2OZVzMnL5U2td44_lj4wYz-MPQICUYxTvqH8-UjLvYkuX1-qPOIVH0jKnqdDDJSh1aHAWRlRg==) .
